It also carries the influence of the Sanskrit language, which is deeply intertwined with Hindu culture and spirituality.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name "Saiful" holds deep spiritual significance, representing the belief that every person is a divine manifestation, a gift from the almighty God. It underscores the Hindu philosophy of selfless devotion and service to others, as one fulfills their dharma or duty towards the world and the divine. This name serves as a constant reminder of one's connection to the divine and fosters a profound sense of humility, reverence, and gratitude.
